question: Do construction-specific head coordinates converge through exact weights onto shared residual writes or downstream reader responses?

searched: temporal shared subspace, downstream reader, and weight atlas records
prior_art.known_lessons: The A1/A2 head axes are individually stable but have only .409-.671 between-construction cosine. Earlier A1-only axes ranked L15H5 interfaces highly, but complete attention-15 bypass means that ranking is not causal identification.
prior_art.novelty: Compare the two construction-specific axes after exact W_O and reader contractions, rather than asking only whether each independently scores the same reader highly.

frozen_design.write_map: For construction e, w_e=W_O[:,h]u_e. Report |cos(w_A1,w_A2)| and its change from |cos(u_A1,u_A2)|.
frozen_design.reader_map: For every later attention Q/K/Q2/K2/V matrix or same/later MLP Left/Right matrix A, compute z_e=A w_e, response alignment |cos(z_A1,z_A2)|, normalized strengths ||z_e||/(||A||_F||w_e||), and joint score alignment*min(strengths).
frozen_design.value_pullback: For each source, compare W_V^T u_A1 and W_V^T u_A2 by absolute cosine.

predictions.pred_a_authority_relative_exact_map_gaug: All hashes/config match; every W_O slice embedding has relative max error <= eight float32 epsilons; sign gauges leave scores invariant <=1e-12; all values are finite; price is exact.
predictions.pred_b_local_geometry_replays_causal_res: All sixteen stored local A1/A2 absolute cosines reproduce the causal-result geometry within 1e-6.
predictions.pred_c_construction_axes_converge_as_res: In both folds, at least three of four sources have |cos(w_A1,w_A2)| >= .75.
predictions.pred_d_l15h5_reads_a_shared_construction: In both folds, at least three of four sources place an L15H5 Q/K/Q2/K2/V response in the top quartile by joint score.
predictions.pred_e_sources_converge_on_one_shared_re: In both folds, at least one exact reader label is top-ten by joint score for at least three of four sources.
predictions.pred_f_value_pullbacks_share_an_upstream: In both folds, at least three of four sources have |cos(W_V^T u_A1,W_V^T u_A2)| >= .75.

decision: C passing supports shared residual writes; D/E passing with C failing supports reader-equivalent distinct writes; F localizes sharing upstream of head values. If C-F fail, the construction-specific coordinates remain distinct through the inspected linear interfaces and the next causal object must include routing or a control-selective nonlinear split. Weight geometry remains a diagnostic screen, never causal reader proof.
